exact_continuation: Add literal concurrent-rotation regressions for iter_call_events and planner_verdict_was_persisted using a barrier between generation enumeration and file opening. Combine them with candidate 009's two-independent-sink Windows rollover regression and build one shared cross-platform event_log_locked/stable-generation snapshot primitive. Compare correctness-first lock-through-scan against pin-handles/end-offsets under lock; verify Windows handle/rename semantics before relying on post-lock handles. Mission View schema-7 full rebuild must use the same stable generation set and preserve the existing v4 migration contract when complete canonical history is unprovable. Retain Variant A/B projection readback tests, candidate-008 durability work, next-invocation Argus-main freshness, and separate Manager transition_id provenance.

run_findings.candidate_010_status: new material reader/writer rotation race: iter_call_events and planner_verdict_was_persisted enumerate event-generation pathnames without events.lock, so a valid concurrent rotation can move a generation outside the frozen pathname list even on POSIX
run_findings.candidate_010_witness: source-shaped planner-verdict simulation snapshotted current,.1,.2; after current was read, rotation moved verdict-bearing .1 to .3 and current to .1; saved pathname scan returned found=false while the verdict remained retained in .3
run_findings.candidate_010_impact: planner-verdict outbox replay uses the persistence scan to decide whether to re-emit; an unstable false negative can trigger unnecessary duplicate verdict append/delivery attempt. iter_call_events can analogously miss the call-start generation or duplicate a renamed generation
run_findings.candidate_010_positive_control: _legacy_manager_handoff_identity already takes a shared POSIX events.lock and opens/pins all generation handles before releasing it, demonstrating the stronger stable-generation pattern inside Argus
run_findings.candidate_010_scope: all platforms/read paths that omit the event lock; unlike candidate009, does not require a broken writer lock or canonical data loss
run_findings.candidate_009_status: Windows writer/writer rollover race remains: event_log.py uses per-instance locks and POSIX fcntl only; without fcntl two sinks can overwrite a retained generation
run_findings.candidate_009_witness: deterministic source-shaped interleaving from .1=P,current=C gives retained P,B,A; C disappears; reproduced twice locally including a 1 MiB current file; not a full Argus Windows test or observed incident
run_findings.candidate_009_adaptation: shared blocking cross-platform event_log_locked keyed by lock path, with POSIX fcntl or Windows msvcrt retry; reuse it for writers and stable reader snapshots while preserving events.lock -> mission-view.lock
run_findings.candidate_007_migration_revision: blanket schema<=6 destructive rebuild is too broad because current tests preserve v4 state without logs; initial public release retained all event generations but schema1 lineage can predate publicly provable complete history. Rebuild only when completeness is demonstrable; otherwise preserve legacy baseline and establish a future cursor/barrier
run_findings.candidate_007_variant_a: pre-replace Mission View loss leaves canonical E1 durable but view behind; fresh-sink E2 must reconcile E1 then E2
run_findings.candidate_007_variant_b: post-replace EIO is ambiguous; read back persisted view/cursor before replay to avoid double-applying non-idempotent E1
run_findings.candidate_007_identity: unknown envelope fields are preserved; sink-owned event_log_id remains low-churn but must be minted once in a shared persisted-event preparation path because handle_event and _append currently normalize twice
run_findings.candidate_007_cursor_benchmark: local synthetic 128 generations / 128k rows / 37.23 MiB: recent-first exact raw-byte ID lookup median newest ~0.015-0.065ms, middle ~4.55ms, oldest ~8.37-8.45ms, missing ~8.22ms; full all-generation JSON parse ~185.72ms; not production filesystem performance
run_findings.candidate_006_status: all-generation cold-recovery mechanism must operate over a rotation-stable generation set and must not assume complete canonical history for every legacy schema
run_findings.candidate_008_status: unchanged separate durability hypothesis: canonical event append/rotation lacks explicit fsync ordering and Mission View lacks parent-directory fsync; no power-loss incident reproduced
run_findings.candidate_005_transition_lineage_patch: optional existing Manager intent ID -> stage_history transition_id remains provenance-only and separate
